sv.title: Dataläcka: Tusentals ryska soldater tar livet av sig
sv.summary: Drygt 1 000 ryssar som registrerats som avlidna under Rysslands invasion sköt sig själva, visar uppgifter som The Guardian tagit del av. Samtidigt tros mörkertalet vara stort, eftersom armén inte vill registrera dödsfallen som självmord.

en.title: Data leak: Thousands of Russian soldiers take their own lives
en.summary: Just over 1,000 Russians registered as dead during Russia's invasion shot themselves, according to data The Guardian has seen. At the same time, the number of unreported cases is believed to be large, as the army does not want to register the deaths as suicides.
